input:
The volume of parallelepiped, whose coterminous edges are u = i + j + lambda k, v = i + j + 3k, w = 2i + j + k is 1 cu. units. If theta is the angle between u and w, then the value of cos(theta) is

Options:
A. 3/4
B. 5/6
C. 1/5
D. 1/6

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Use volume condition to find lambda, then compute cosine between u and w.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Volume gives determinant equation in lambda.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Compute determinant to determine lambda from volume, then use dot product formula.
logical_steps: Step 3: Select lambda consistent with options

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Only lambda=2 yields the listed option after satisfying volume condition.
